## Statistical intuition (interactive)

- [Seeing Theory](https://seeing-theory.brown.edu): [probability](https://seeing-theory.brown.edu/basic-probability/index.html) and [distributions](https://seeing-theory.brown.edu/probability-distributions/index.html) (S4), [inference](https://seeing-theory.brown.edu/frequentist-inference/index.html) (S5–S6), [regression](https://seeing-theory.brown.edu/regression-analysis/index.html) (S7)
- R Psychologist: [CIs](https://rpsychologist.com/d3/CI/), [power](https://rpsychologist.com/d3/NHST/), [p-values](https://rpsychologist.com/pvalue/), [Cohen's d](https://rpsychologist.com/cohend/), [correlation](https://rpsychologist.com/correlation/)
- [Guess the Correlation](https://www.guessthecorrelation.com); [p-hacker](https://shinyapps.org/apps/p-hacker/); [Spurious Correlations](https://www.tylervigen.com/spurious-correlations); [Datasaurus Dozen](https://jumpingrivers.github.io/datasauRus/)

## R, data and Quarto

- Wickham et al., [*R for Data Science* (2e)](https://r4ds.hadley.nz)
- Grolemund, [*Hands-On Programming with R*](https://rstudio-education.github.io/hopr/)
- PsyTeachR, [*Data Skills for Reproducible Research*](https://psyteachr.github.io/reprores-v4/)
- [Posit cheatsheets](https://posit.co/resources/cheatsheets/) (dplyr, ggplot2, purrr, Quarto)
- [Quarto documentation](https://quarto.org)
- Bryan, [*Happy Git and GitHub for the useR*](https://happygitwithr.com)
- Stuck? [Posit Community](https://forum.posit.co), with a minimal reproducible example

## Visualisation

- [From Data to Viz](https://www.data-to-viz.com); [R Graph Gallery](https://r-graph-gallery.com)
- Wickham et al., [*ggplot2*](https://ggplot2-book.org); Wilke, [*Fundamentals of Data Visualization*](https://clauswilke.com/dataviz/)
- Colour-blind safe palettes: [viridis](https://sjmgarnier.github.io/viridis/), [ColorBrewer](https://colorbrewer2.org)

## Beyond this course

- **Repeated measures** (trials, sessions, recordings per subject) are not independent. Here we average or pair; the proper tool is a mixed model: [`lme4`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=lme4); Yu et al. (2022), [Beyond t test and ANOVA](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuron.2021.10.030), *Neuron*.
- **Neuro data in R:** [Neuroconductor](https://neuroconductor.org), [`eegUtils`](https://craddm.github.io/eegUtils/), [`eeguana`](https://github.com/bnicenboim/eeguana), [`ggseg`](https://github.com/ggseg/ggseg). Open data: [OpenNeuro](https://openneuro.org), [OSF](https://osf.io) ...
